# Chocolate Cream Cake

## Ingredients

- 1/2 cupful butter
- 1 cupful sugar
- 4 egg whites, stiffly beaten
- 1 1/2 cupfuls flour
- 1 teaspoonful baking-powder
- vanilla, for flavoring
- 1 1/2 cupfuls sugar (for syrup)
- 1/2 cupful milk (for syrup)
- melted chocolate, for topping

## Instructions

1. Cream half a cupful of butter with one cupful of sugar.
2. Add the stiffly beaten whites of four eggs.
3. Sift in one and one-half cupfuls of flour with a teaspoonful of baking-powder.
4. Flavor with vanilla.
5. Bake in a square tin.
6. Boil one and one-half cupfuls of sugar with half a cupful of milk until the syrup makes a soft ball when dropped in cold water.
7. Flavor with vanilla, stir until thick.
8. Spread on the cake and pour melted chocolate on top.
